utility_use_case: A research team exports the same instrument dataset into several project folders and wants to estimate avoidable storage before archiving. Run `bash duplicate-report.sh --root ./assets`, inspect the JSON paths and byte totals, then verify provenance and retention requirements manually. The report is read-only: it does not identify the canonical copy or remove files.
